messages:
alex: Heads-up — Acme POC just asked for the SOC 2 report + an NDA before we hand over any evidence for the integration test. They want files and an engineer session next week.
jenna: OK. Do they want the full report or a redacted extract? We usually redacted vendor-identifying info for presigned links.
mike: I can host the artifacts on a presigned S3 link for 72h. Need legal signoff on the NDA + confirmation on allowed reviewers.
sam-legal: @alex thanks. Please get the customer's signed NDA PDF attached here. For SOC 2 we can provide the latest report with PII redacted. Also ask them to sign our short access attestation (one-pager) — legal wants that for temporary evidence access.
alex: copying what they asked in their email: "Can you share SOC 2 Type II and any bridge letter if available? We'll need an NDA signed for evidence access and a 2-hour pairing session with your infra engineer."
jenna: For the bridge-letter: we have a short acknowledgement (not a replacement for SOC2) — legal can produce a one-off attestation. @sam-legal can you draft? :pray:
sam-legal: On it. I can do a bridge attestation referencing the report date and our scope. Will aim to have a draft by EOD. Need the customer's legal contact to sign the NDA first.
tara: For the engineer session, who from our side? I can volunteer to do the pairing for infra-level stuff but need to know if they require access to a live tenant or just logs/evidence.
mike: They asked to inspect audit logs + a sample backup manifest. We should not give tenant creds. We can provide logs and a sanitized manifest via presigned link.
security-bot: Incident bot: Evidence upload completed to s3://redwood-sec-evidence/1918888000/ — presigned URL generated, expires 72 hours after creation.
ops-oncall: @mike please include ACLs and the exact expiration time in the message to the customer. Also record the IP ranges allowed for access in case security wants to audit.
alex: Next steps I propose:
- Send NDA (from sam-legal) to customer for signature
- Once signed, upload redacted SOC2 + attestation to presigned S3 and share link
- Schedule 2-hour pairing session; tara will lead the session
- Limit download window to 72h and log downloads
Sound good?
jenna: Sounds good. Add in the email that we do not share production credentials and that any further evidence requests will go through a formal evidence request process.
sam-legal: Draft NDA + bridge attestation attached to thread (uploaded). NDA has one minor clause the customer asked to change re: mutual indemnification — I marked that in the doc with comments.
alex: Thanks. I'll send to Acme legal and cc @jenna. Copy of the presigned link will be posted after they return the signed NDA.
mike: Preparing upload now. Example presigned URL (placeholder):

```
https://s3-presigned.example/1918888000/soc2-redacted.pdf?X-Amz-Expires=259200
```

Will replace with real one after signoff.
tara: For the pairing session, prefer Wed 10-12 PST. I can demo log query process and evidence redaction steps.
alex: I'll propose Wed 10-12 PST. @sam-legal please confirm NDA turnaround time. Also ask them to provide a list of reviewers (names + emails) — we'll restrict access to those identities.
sam-legal: Estimated turnaround: 24–48 hours if no major changes. Also flagged the mutual indemnity item for their counsel.
jenna: FYI — SalesOps: please set a POC label in CRM and mark 'requires SOC2/NDA' so AE follow-ups are tracked.
ops-oncall: Logged request in the evidence audit: ticket #EVID-2026 (retention metadata + ACLs). Will attach download logs after the window closes.
alex: Great — I'll update the customer thread. Will post signed NDA & link here once I get it. :thumbsup:
jenna: Thanks all. Small note — if they ask for the full unredacted logs that will need a deeper compliance review; we'll route to Security.
mike: Understood. Will hold off on uploading anything until NDA is signed and legal confirms redaction is sufficient.
sam-legal: Drafts are in the thread. Ping me if Acme counters anything substantial.
alex: Closing loop here — sending NDA now. Will follow up in this thread with the signed doc + presigned link.
